text:
maria: Quick ping — docs link-scan flagged ~28 orphan anchors across runtime-guide and kv-cache pages. Snippet:
```bash
$ docscan --scan runtime-guide kv-cache
FOUND: runtime/latency.md:line 142: [see batching](#batching-optimizations)
FOUND: kv-cache/README.md:line 77: [prefix cache](#prefix-cache-behavior)
... total 28 matches ...
```
Who can sherpa small PRs this week? Prefer folks on docs rota or eng-runtime. Thanks.

docscanbot: Automated scan report generated. Scan ID: scan-2923. https://internal/reports/scan-2923 (summary attached)

alex: I can take the runtime-guide ones (4). Will open PRs named `fix/orphan-anchors/runtime` and tag `docs:links`.

ines: I can pick up kv-cache + batching pages (6). Quick q — do we canonicalize to full internal URLs or replace with section links when the target exists?

maria: prefer canonical internal URLs (full path) where the target doc exists. If page was removed, add a 301 shortlink redirect instead of leaving an orphan anchor. Add `docs:links` label on the PR so QA knows to run the link smoke check.

tess: heads-up — if any anchors reference images that are 403 in staging, don't rehost automatically. Create an infra ticket for S3 rehost and ping @oliver.

oliver: noted. If you list asset paths I can open an S3 rehost task and provision staging creds. Leave the asset list in the PR description.

sam: quick — do we need to update CODEOWNERS for runtime/kv-cache changes, or just tag `eng-runtime` in the PR assignees?

ines: don't add CODEOWNERS unless you're changing the top-level folder structure. Tag `eng-runtime` in the PR and add `docs-team` as reviewer for fast merge.

alex: FYI opened PRs: #4026 and #4027 for runtime anchors. Small edits, CI smoke passed. Tagged `docs:links` and `eng-runtime`.

maria: awesome, thanks — I'll compile a short checklist and drop it here for folks doing the PRs. :thumbsup:

maria: Checklist for PRs:
1) List orphan anchors found + file paths
2) Replace with canonical internal URL OR add redirect shortlink
3) Add `docs:links` label and reference Scan ID scan-2923
4) If touching asset images, list them and ping @oliver
5) Small CI smoke + `docs-team` review
6) Add comment with migration rationale if redirecting

tess: can we add a tiny automation: when PR has `docs:links` label, trigger link-smoke job and add a comment with scan ID? @maria would you file a follow-up RFC?

maria: yes, I'll open an RFC in docs/infra next week — short proposal to wire label -> job and auto-comment.

alex: merged runtime PRs, closing my items.

ines: opened kv-cache PR #4031, added the asset list for two images. @oliver please assign S3 task when you have a sec.

sam: reviewing #4031 now, will push a small nitfix for a relative path.

alex: little tip — this sed helped me replace bad anchors safely: `git grep -n "\[.*](#" | cut -d: -f1 | xargs -n1 sed -n '1,200p'` (use with care).
